scope: reproducibility snapshot during source training, not a replacement for the initial registration

base_config_contents.status: exploratory small-model new-combination pilot; not the original full-scale training protocol
base_config_contents.selection_policy: fixed known circuits; null controls minimize source-label-statistic distance with equal expanded affine pair count; no neural outcomes used
base_config_contents.evaluation_policy: all source training, validation, representation, target support and target test inputs are globally disjoint; no target-test tuning
limitations: Source label marginals and task difficulty are not exactly matched.
No separately trained single-task controls in this pilot.
Null means no proved rational linear identity of the audited form, not absence of all mathematical relationships.
Two layers and answer-token-only loss differ from the original full-scale protocol.
